findings.observed: Native Menu opens partly outside a 390px viewport with 32px Firefox text. Links begin at x=-67.38 on four main pages. The 701–720px header also occupies 201px.
findings.acceptance: Keep all native links visible and keyboard reachable. Recheck 320px and tablet transitions at default and enlarged text.

findings.observed: Daily’s two 169px phone selects crop visible values at 390px with enlarged text. Company news needs 268px.
findings.acceptance: Display full selected values, retain search/reset behavior and preserve the compact default layout.

findings.observed: The keyword and filter outlines have 1.26:1 contrast against the page.
findings.acceptance: Use a distinguishable field boundary and retain keyboard focus styling.

findings.observed: The 320px search field gives its 226px hint 192px. Firefox’s translucent placeholder has 3.60:1 contrast.
findings.acceptance: Use a short legible hint and retain the searchable categories in the existing help text.

findings.observed: At 390px the first role title is plain text at y559 and its issuer action starts at y1042. The company link already leads to the exact local role.
findings.acceptance: Make the visible title take the reader to the exact local role while preserving the separate issuer action, source history and CSV.

findings.observed: The official Mobile WebKit trace restored a focused Mercor result at scroll 113, then lost the saved position 33 ms later. The retry passed.
findings.acceptance: Restore the exact cold-Back position after a late browser reset. Respect a reader who scrolls and preserve cached and Forward behavior.

findings.observed: After Clear filters, Firefox classic restores all 16 Daily stories on Forward but closes the previously opened Search field and sends the next Tab to Skip.
findings.acceptance: Restore Clear’s open search and correct keyboard focus without reopening a deliberately closed panel.

findings.observed: After opening the Market matrix, keyboard readers traverse 234 controls to reach Definitions.
findings.acceptance: Provide a visible keyboard shortcut to the Definitions summary that retains filters and matrix state.

findings.observed: The selected measure announces descending even when sorting is grouped by currency, basis and proxy.
findings.acceptance: Announce the grouped ordering accurately and retain financial comparability and row order.

findings.observed: 25 unavailable Paid delivery cells use Expert activity as the primary accessible name.
findings.acceptance: Name the visible measure in the button and dialog, then explain the underlying concept where appropriate.
